abstract: The pattern of urological malignancy among the indigenous population of Zambia (determined on the basis of histopathological reports from a major national hospital during an 8-year period) is presented. A total of 6514 malignancies were observed, of which 784 (12%) were of urological origin. Bladder carcinoma, predominantly squamous type, was the commonest urological tumour (51%), followed by carcinoma of the prostate (26%), carcinoma of the penis (18%), renal tumours (4.3%) and testicular malignancy (0.7%). In nearly 32% of the bladder tumours, bilharzial ova were demonstrated histopathologically. Nephroblastoma accounted for 70% of the renal tumours and from a total of 7 cases of testicular tumours 5 were embryonal carcinoma and 2 seminoma. A brief reference is made to the pattern and aetiology of urological malignancies in some neighbouring countries.
abstract_ja: ザンビアにおける泌尿器悪性腫瘍の様相：病院ベースの組織病理学的研究。ザンビアの先住民における泌尿器悪性腫瘍の様相を、8年間に国内の主要病院から得られた組織病理学的報告に基づいて示す。総計6514例の悪性腫瘍が認められ、そのうち784例（12%）が泌尿器由来であった。膀胱癌（主に扁平上皮型）が最も多い泌尿器腫瘍（51%）であり、次いで前立腺癌（26%）、陰茎癌（18%）、腎腫瘍（4.3%）、精巣悪性腫瘍（0.7%）であった。膀胱腫瘍の約32%では、組織学的に住血吸虫卵が認められた。腎芽腫は腎腫瘍の70%を占めた。精巣腫瘍7例のうち5例は胎児性癌、2例はセミノーマであった。近隣諸国の泌尿器悪性腫瘍の様相と病因についても簡単に言及する。
